-- Conversion rates by industry (last 90 days)
SELECT
  l.client_id,
  c.industry,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)                                              AS total_leads,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'reply_received'
        THEN l.id END)                                              AS replied,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'meeting_booked'
        THEN l.id END)                                              AS meetings,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lo.deal_result = 'won'
        THEN l.id END)                                              AS won,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'reply_received'
        THEN l.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id), 0), 1)       AS reply_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'meeting_booked'
        THEN l.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id), 0), 1)       AS meeting_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lo.deal_result = 'won'
        THEN l.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id), 0), 1)       AS win_rate
FROM leads l
JOIN companies c ON c.id = l.company_id
LEFT JOIN sales_metrics sm ON sm.lead_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN lead_outcomes lo ON lo.lead_id = l.id
WHERE l.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY l.client_id, c.industry
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) >= 3
ORDER BY meeting_rate DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  l.client_id,
  sm.seniority,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)                                              AS total_leads,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'reply_received'
        THEN l.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id), 0), 1)       AS reply_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'meeting_booked'
        THEN l.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id), 0), 1)       AS meeting_rate
FROM leads l
JOIN sales_metrics sm ON sm.lead_id = l.id
WHERE l.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND sm.seniority IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.client_id, sm.seniority
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) >= 3
ORDER BY meeting_rate DESC
LIMIT 15;

-- Which step generates the first reply + avg touches to meeting
SELECT
  sm.sequence_step,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS total_sent,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'reply_received' THEN 1 END)     AS replies,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'meeting_booked' THEN 1 END)     AS meetings,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'reply_received'
        THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)                      AS reply_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'meeting_booked'
        THEN sm.sequence_step END), 1)                             AS avg_step_to_meeting
FROM sales_metrics sm
WHERE sm.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND sm.sequence_step IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sm.sequence_step
ORDER BY sm.sequence_step ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  sm.variant_group,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'email_sent'      THEN 1 END)    AS sent,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'reply_received'  THEN 1 END)    AS replies,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'meeting_booked'  THEN 1 END)    AS meetings,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'reply_received'
        THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'email_sent'
        THEN 1 END), 0), 1)                                        AS reply_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'meeting_booked'
        THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'email_sent'
        THEN 1 END), 0), 1)                                        AS meeting_rate
FROM sales_metrics sm
WHERE sm.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND sm.variant_group IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sm.variant_group
ORDER BY meeting_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'email_sent'     THEN 1 END)  AS emails_sent,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'reply_received' THEN 1 END)  AS replies,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'meeting_booked' THEN 1 END)  AS meetings_booked,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sm.lead_id)                                     AS unique_leads_touched,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.status = 'pending'
        THEN e.id END)                                           AS open_escalations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.id)                                          AS signals_detected,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'reply_received' THEN 1 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN sm.event_type = 'email_sent' THEN 1 END), 0),
    1)                                                           AS overall_reply_rate
FROM sales_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN escalations e   ON e.created_at   > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
LEFT JOIN company_signals cs ON cs.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
WHERE sm.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days';

values.content:
You are an expert B2B sales analytics AI producing a weekly performance report for a sales team.

Analyze the data and produce a concise, actionable report. Focus on:
- What is working (highest converting segments, best-performing steps)
- What needs attention (low performers, anomalies)
- 3 specific, concrete recommendations for next week

Output ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys:
{
  "executive_summary": "2-3 sentences — the most important takeaway this week",
  "top_insights": ["4-5 specific data-driven observations, each one sentence"],
  "winning_segments": ["top 2-3 industry or seniority segments by meeting rate"],
  "underperforming": ["top 1-2 segments or steps that need attention"],
  "recommendations": ["3 specific actions for next week — each actionable, not generic"],
  "best_sequence_step": "which step number drives the most replies",
  "variant_winner": "A or B or inconclusive — which variant is winning"
}

-- Won deals in last 90 days with the winning sequence step email body
SELECT
  lo.lead_id,
  lo.winning_step,
  lo.deal_value,
  l.client_id,
  l.icp_tier        AS tier,
  l.title           AS seniority,
  c.industry,
  ss.subject,
  ss.body_text,
  ss.strategy_used  AS signal_used
FROM lead_outcomes lo
JOIN leads         l  ON l.id  = lo.lead_id
JOIN companies     c  ON c.id  = l.company_id
LEFT JOIN sequence_steps ss
  ON ss.sequence_id  = l.sequence_id
 AND ss.step_number  = lo.winning_step
WHERE lo.deal_result  = 'won'
  AND lo.created_at  > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND lo.winning_step IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 50;

UPDATE client_configs
SET
  config = jsonb_set(
    config,
    '{icp_config, industry_weights}',
    $2::jsonb,
    true   -- create key if missing
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE client_id = $1::uuid
  AND $3 = FALSE;

INSERT INTO activities (type, lead_id, payload, created_at)
VALUES ('analytics_run', NULL, $1::jsonb, NOW());
